opener_concept: A multiplying machine works out (x-2)(x-3). Testing x=5 (both brackets positive) then x=2.5 (one bracket positive, one negative) shows a positive times a negative is negative, so the expression drops below zero only BETWEEN the two roots. The reveal names this 'between the roots' as the whole method.
